categories.evidence: Matches the 'Tests' label and touches src/bench/ to add microbenchmark harnesses for BIP-352 parsing.
categories.rationale: Adds microbenchmarks to track performance regressions in BIP-352 public key extraction across standard and worst-case script inputs. While valuable for evaluating ongoing changes to bip352::GetPubKeyFromInput, adding microbenchmarks is deferrable.
